selection_policy_and_overview.選定理由: 承認済みL3/L10（HELIXOS-L3-007-F01〜F03 / HELIXOS-L10-007-F01〜F03）およびL4基本設計prose（HELIXOS-L4-007-F01〜F03とdiagnostic_contractのR01〜R12・全37診断code）に基づき、R01/R02相当の共通フィールド/型/lineage照合だけでなく、L4が持つすべての規則族（F01共通ログkind/state/success_evidence_claim: R01〜R03、F02 feedback原finding保全/stage記録整合/source_head結合/resolution_origin制限/未解決の解決主張禁止: R04〜R07、F03 memory正本反映先結合/state・freshness閉集合/reflection・retire順序整合/terminal再提示禁止/deliver・consume回数と状態の整合/provider memory正本化禁止: R08〜R11、全体完了主張禁止・優先順位集約・原記録保持: R12）を漏れなく網羅するよう10の代表negative行（NEG-OS007-R01〜NEG-OS007-R12）および全37診断codeの完全マトリクスを選定した。
rule_families_covered: R01: Common string & boolean comparison primitives (field_unknown, field_conflict, boolean_unknown, boolean_conflict)
R02: Four-log common fields, closed log kind, fixture-key kind match, and log state (log_kind_unknown, log_kind_conflict, log_state_unknown, log_state_conflict, log_duplicate, log_stale)
R03: Log success_evidence_claim prohibition and per-log log_material_usable gating (log_success_claim_forbidden, boolean_unknown)
R04: Feedback original_finding dict/canonical-whole preservation and discard_original_claim prohibition (finding_missing, original_finding_changed, finding_discard_forbidden)

R05: Feedback 5-stage recording consistency, unrecorded non-null ref rejection, and stage.source_head join to context original_finding.source_head (stage_unrecorded_ref_present, field_unknown, field_conflict, boolean_unknown, boolean_conflict)

R06: Feedback resolution_origin closed-set / canonical-only enforcement and unresolved_claimed_resolved prohibition (resolution_origin_unknown, resolution_origin_forbidden, unresolved_claimed_resolved)
R07: Feedback material correspondence aggregation and non-elevation of actual_feedback_resolved

R08: Memory source fields, closed state/freshness, reflection.recorded consistency, unrecorded reflection field/order rejection, and reflection-to-source 5-field join (memory_state_unknown, memory_state_conflict, memory_freshness_unknown, memory_freshness_conflict, reflection_unrecorded_ref_present)

R09: Memory reflection.order & retire_order positive-int check and actual state=retired ordering enforcement (order_unknown, order_conflict, retire_before_reflection, retirement_basis_unknown, reflection_not_before_retire)

R10: Memory terminal/stale active resurfacing prohibition, deliver/consume count & state consistency, and provider_authority_claim prohibition (terminal_instruction_resurfaced, use_count_unknown, use_count_conflict, duplicate_successful_use, consume_without_delivery, use_state_conflict, provider_memory_authority_forbidden)
R11: Memory material correspondence and per-entry active_material_eligible isolation

R12: Boundary whole_completion_claim prohibition, violation > unknown > corresponding precedence, finding deduplication/sorting, deepcopied record retention, and all actual/effect flags forced false/none (whole_completion_forbidden, whole_claim_unknown)
